title: Disarm and Infuriate with the Mirror Effect
coreMove: Reflect people back to themselves so their own pattern disarms or unsettles them
sourcePressure: Chapter 44 centers on the mirror effect: reflecting people back to themselves in ways that disarm, unsettle, or provoke them. The law argues that mirroring can be powerful because people are often disturbed when confronted with their own style, aggression, or assumptions from the outside. Its limit is that mirroring should not be treated as mystical imitation or used without regard for escalation and context. Frozen sidecar provides no traceable named anecdote for this chapter; do not fabricate named source anchors.
